ModMetaData.name: RimToll
ModMetaData.author: BenFD
ModMetaData.description:
You hold the land. The road crosses it. The road pays.
Info.
Vanilla walks travelers, visitors and trade caravans across your map for free. RimToll puts a toll post on that road, and now they stop at it.
Build the “Toll” spot and there you go. No need for a trade route or anything else, place it wherever you want, and the pawns will go to the nearest one.
I intentionally made it just one spot so that everyone can take turns building (see image in the gallery).
Compatibility and Performance Safe to add to an existing save. Performance friendly Works with Hospitality, Silk Road
You can change several values in the mod's settings
Enjoying RimToll? A quick thumbs up really helps. Every rating helps more people find it.
Fourth mod: RimJoust for the tourney, RimSiege for war, RimFeast for peace, RimToll for the paperwork. So much for the trilogy.
BenFD
